client_frame: **Monday delivered a rare setup: strike-cancel-induced risk-on PLUS a genuine ISM Manufacturing blowout (55.6 vs 53.7 cons) with Employment flipping to expansion after 33 months and Production at highest since 2021**. Result: THREE indices closed at new records simultaneously — SPX 7,600.50, DJI 53,178.41, NDX 28,776.80. The most interesting cross-current: **yields actually FELL** — US10Y -5.7bp to 4.688%, US2Y -10.8bp to 4.252% — a bull steepener DESPITE the manufacturing surge. That's inconsistent with the ECI-hot / hawkish-Warsh narrative that dominated Fri, and suggests either (a) rate-cut hopes reviving, (b) 30Y-at-5% demand pulling front end, or (c) safe-haven flows persisting despite the rally. VIX further compressed to 15.86. **The critical fragility**: **Iran signals are diverging** — Iran's president claims MOU signed, but Iran's FM spokesperson DENIED talks are even happening, and Hormuz shipping traffic remains at multi-month lows (only 6 vessels Mon per Reuters). Trump's Sat 'perimeters' announcement has not translated into observable behavior. Oil is essentially flat vs Mon's -4.6% settle — market is not confident this holds. **Today's tape**: (1) JOLTS 10am is the actual signal, not the noise — a low print reinforces bull steepener; (2) AMD tonight 5pm is the tech read — hyperscaler capex ($11.3-11.4B rev, $1.60-1.63 EPS cons) and MI350 ramp commentary matter; (3) PLTR's Mon beat + raised guide sets AI-defense narrative bar for AMD. **Client positioning**: (a) DO NOT sell the strength — this is a real breadth expansion with ISM Employment expansion + record indices + yields falling; (b) But keep some cheap VIX call protection (still 15.86) — the Iran deal is not signed and 'perimeters' has been reversed twice in 2026; (c) Tech longs into AMD tonight carry earnings risk — trim ahead if size is aggressive; (d) NFP Fri 8/7 (cons +87-91k) is still THE catalyst — bull steepener continues if number cools; hawkish reversal if hot. (e) 30Y watch: if long end stays 5.00% while front end rallies, that curve steepening is a real regime signal.
